item.title: WinUI 3 developer digest — October 3, 2026
item.description: WinUI 3 developer digest — October 3, 2026 Archive: Revised October 3, 13:58 PDT; collection cutoff 13:57:00 PDT. Latest-day focus: Oct 2, 13:57:00 → Oct 3, 13:57:00 PDT. Seven-day catch-up: Sept 26–Oct 3, continuing partial initial coverage. Useful verified stories from this morning are retained, with earlier-window activity labeled separately. A shipping community control fills another gap: RibbonSpace now supports plain WinUI 3, with concrete porting lessons. Important correction to this morning's ItemsView story: new contributor tests implicate stable releases too; Loaded plus dispatcher deferral is not a sufficient zero-viewport guard. Search works, source access still doesn't: DuckDuckGo surfaced human Stack Overflow Q&A, but blocked originals and unverified dates prevent treating snippets as new fixes. item.title: WinUI 3 developer-community digest — October 2, 2026
item.description: WinUI 3 developer-community digest — October 2, 2026 Coverage: October 1, 08:30 → October 2, 08:30 PDT. Seven-day catch-up searches; previously reported stories excluded. Overall coverage is partial. Takeaways Packaging gets tangible fixes: a published MSIX BuildTools update addresses resource/publish failures—not merely a promised source change. Practical gotchas: scope WindowsAppSDKSelfContained to the executable, and don’t equate successful notification calls with visible toasts. Input performance: fresh ColorPicker reports implicate high mouse polling rates; users provide a mitigation and debugging evidence, not a confirmed framework fix. Community experience SimpleFiles: a student ships a native file manager. Reddit r/SideProject, October 1.
